bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 170, Number 49 (Wednesday, March 20, 2024)]
[House]
[Pages H1295-H1296]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Ms. SCHAKOWSKY:
H.R. 7756.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8, Clause 3: The Congress shall have
Power . . . To regulate Commerce
[[Page H1296]]
with foreign Nations, and among the several States, and with
the Indian Tribes.
The single subject of this legislation is:
To expand the scope of the Do Not Call rules under the
Telephone Consumer Protection Act to include all telephone
subscribers, and to expand the private right of action for
calls in violation of those rules.
